To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
$\textit{we show that it is feasible, without supervision, to disentangle syntactic roles in sentence representations.}$

1. we propose a deep generative model, ADVAE, that enables unsupervised disentanglement in sentence representations; 2. we develop an evaluation protocol for disentanglement that is based on attention and on disturbing latent variables; 3. our model outperforms classical sequence VAE models in terms of syntactic role disentanglement
we propose a novel probabilistic model that allows for unsupervised disentanglement between latent variables and syntactic roles, which we evaluate using a novel protocol.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: $\textit{i)$}$ Can syntactic roles be disentangled in unsupervised sentence representations?
$\bullet$

1) the development of deep generative models for sentence representations, 2) the analysis of the disentanglement between latent variables and syntactic roles, 3) the development of evaluation protocols for unsupervised content disentanglement, 4) the development of controllable content generation methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have shown that disentangling the content of sentences is possible without supervision and we have proposed a method to measure this disentanglement.

the proposed ADVAE model is able to disentangle syntactic roles from sentences without any supervision, and that it is possible for the first time to modify these syntactic roles by merely modifying latent variables.

the authors propose a model that is able to generate sentences in a controllable way, i.e. it is possible to control the syntactic roles of the sentence, and the authors also show that the latent variables are disentangled from the input tokens.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose an unsupervised model that can disentangle different syntactic roles in sentence representation, and can generate different sentences with the same meaning, but with different syntactic roles.
it is possible, without supervision, to obtain representations of sentences where each syntactic role corresponds to a different latent variable.

we have developed a model that can disentangle different aspects of sentences (e.g. syntactic roles) in an unsupervised way and can generate sentences with the same meaning but with different syntactic roles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible, without supervision, to induce disentanglement in sentence representations, and thus to control the realizations of the syntactic roles of sentences.
, without supervision, it is possible to induce a separation of latent variables in the decoder of an ADVAE that is correlated with syntactic roles in the encoder.
, in a deep generative model, it is possible to disentangle the content of the sentences by inducing the separation of latent variables with regard to the syntactic roles.
